author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

[GO:0052861](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0052861)    endo-1,3(4)-beta-glucanase activity
There are 2 manual annotations to this, one is a NOT.

I'm not sure that the term should exist ? It doesn't have a RHEA mapping and seems to be a compound term?

I'm getting InterPro mappings to 

GO:0052861 | endo-1,3(4)-beta-glucanase activity | IEA with IPR005200

for 
glucan endo-1,3-beta-D-glucosidase activity


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/term/GO:0052861
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC821.09
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC23D3.10c
title: InterPro2GO issue:  IPR005200

author: sarach06
body:
Dear Val,
Thank you very much for this. Yes, I can't see enough evidence for that term. I replaced it with GO:0042973: glucan endo-1,3-beta-D-glucosidase activity for which there is more evidence and is abetter one for these proteins. Let me know if you agree.

Best wishes,
Sara

body:
